rust_summary: submitting bounded depth-tested world primitives and full-screen tint or vignette for a client frame.
doc_summary: `draw_world_line(start, end, color, width)`, `draw_world_quad(corners, color)`, `draw_world_textured_quad(corners, uv, color, texture)` and `draw_world_billboard(center, size, uv, color, texture)` submit during a client world frame hook. Color is ARGB; line width is 0.5 to 4 pixels, billboard dimensions are positive and at most 256 blocks, and UV rectangles are normalized. At most 256 requests per mod are queued each frame; a round-robin, rotating per-mod selection shares the total 256-primitive rendering budget without first-mod starvation. Draws are depth-tested without depth writes, consumed once and discarded beyond 256 camera blocks. Lines crossing the near plane are clipped. Texture views and bind groups are cached. World-draw GUI texture handles are owner-checked and retained across renderer reload; CPU-backed textures are restored after device loss, but GPU-only external textures cannot be reconstructed then. Invalid draw sources are disabled and logged once; `world_draw_state()` reports the calling mod's sticky failure, including across renderer recreation. For late submission use RenderNeeds::pre_post and WorldPrePost.draws with @API:world_pre_post@. Empty queues add no passes or allocations. `draw_post_tint(color)` and `draw_post_vignette(color)` accept at most 16 full-screen effects per frame before the HUD. Vignette alpha controls darkening strength. Bundles need @API:world_lines@.
